feeds.title: Patrick McLaurin's Bagpipe Blog
feeds.description: Patrick McLaurin is an passionate Bagpiper. He shares all his Bagpipe Instruction and video lessons on this blog.

feeds.title: British Columbia Pipers' Association
feeds.description: A volunteer driven organization serving Highland Bagpipers, Scottish drummers, and Bagpipe bands in British Columbia, Washington, and Oregon. BCPA promotes piping and drumming education and understanding in our community. We have one of the most talented groups of musicians, instructors, adjudicators and pipe bands in the world among our membership, and provide a variety of services that support the continued improvement of piping and drumming.

feeds.title: Piping Press Blog
feeds.description: Piping Press is the web magazine arm of PP Publishing and Piping a company specialising in quality journalism covering Scotland's national music that of the great Highland bagpipe. Read this blog for news, views, and information from the piping and pipe band world.

feeds.title: pipes | drums
feeds.description: Pipes|Drums strives to provide news, reviews, and features of journalistic professional-standard integrity and balance. Here every news story attempts to provide relevant sides of the discussion, with the ultimate purpose of providing information while stimulating constructive dialog.

feeds.title: Bagpipe Player
feeds.description: Bagpipeplayers.com is based in Woodland Hills. A single Bagpipe Player for Hire or bagpipers and drummers perform for weddings and memorials with top notch skill- many times a month.

feeds.title: Dunaber Music
feeds.description: Dunaber Music is an independant producer and publisher of of Celtic music mostly of the Highland bagpipe kind by Michael Grey. Here you will find samples of his stuff MP3 Samples, 60 80 second sound clips, extract of his books, stories, tips, techniques and more.

feeds.title: The City of Leeds Pipeband
feeds.description: Formed in 1960, the pipe band has championship success to its credit as well as television appearances and continental tours. The band is made up of volunteers of all ages who enjoy the playing of pipes or drums, and we would welcome new members either experienced or beginners. Here you can find news of their upcoming events, teachings of the music, instructions for comportment which is used in the essentials of marching in various types of formation and more.

feeds.title: Dooagh Pipe Band
feeds.description: This is the website of the community bagpipe band from Dooagh, Achill. Follow this blog to find information about their traditional pipe band and events from Achill Island.

feeds.title: Brisbane Bagpiper Blog
feeds.description: Brisbane Bagpiper Nick Tomkins provides unmatched quality bagpiping for your wedding, funeral, party, corporate or community event. Here we provide bagpiping news, and some handy tips and reviews for those bagpipers who want to take their piping to the next level. Follow this blog to get some idea's on how to incorporate a bagpiper into your event.

feeds.title: Bagpipe Entertainment Blog
feeds.description: Cathedral Piper Tyrone Heade performs bagpipe music for events with audiences small & large. He performs with the Highland bagpipe and Scottish Small pipe. Here he offer a view 'behind the curtain' of all things Bagpipe. Details about his background, including non-profit bagpipe volunteerism, performances of note, awards etc.

feeds.title: Scott Currie Ltd
feeds.description: Scott Currie Ltd is a pipe band piping and percussion instruments and accessories store and online shop specialising in top brand bagpipes, chanters, reeds, piping accessories, pipe band drums, drum carriers, instrument cases, drum heads, snare drum sticks, bass and tenor mallets, percussion accessories and multimedia. Follow this blog to get Insights on product news and announcements from Scott Currie Ltd.

feeds.title: THE BAGPIPER BLOG
feeds.description: Gary Guth is a professional bagpiper with over 45 years of playing experience and has been teaching bagpipes full time for the last 20 years. He has written 'Bagpipes For Beginners', 'the Bagpipe Hymnal', and ' A Piper's Christmas'. Follow this blog to learn more about the bagpipe music education.

feeds.title: Joyful Noise Bagpiping
feeds.description: Joyful Noise Bagpiping has been proud to perform and service Central Florida. Robert Larcom, Owner and Musician based out of Dunedin, prides himself on quality music and a unque memory to last a lifetime! Here you will find his views and thoughts as a Tampa Bay bagpiper.
